prior_failure.cause: File-truncation test attached the expected-rejection assertion after awaited file I/O. Worker rejection could occur first. Handler now attaches before the I/O yield; assertions and production behavior unchanged.

limitations: One grayscale document and three selected pages, not color/other-codec coverage.
Decode rows are from Pillow/libjpeg-turbo, not independently observed native-viewer decoder rows.
Unchanged Interpolate controls do not establish that the flag is universally ignored.
Page geometry, original-image payload equivalence, device quantization and resampling remain unresolved.

This batch uses the font-work branch, not a fresh main comparison. #534 was already closed through the unresolved-classification path in merged #538; this batch does not resolve the remaining visual differences.
No new conversion compatibility or runtime/fidelity pass. Existing 77-page cohort still differs.
